display_long_description:
Welcome to Project Pepsi! We’re thrilled to have you jump into this unique, heart-pounding experience where calm meets chaos and your hands are your only way to move. Forget traditional locomotion—using the Gorilla Movement System, you’ll glide, climb, and launch yourself through serene yet energetic environments with speed, control, and style. Whether you’re chasing others or finding your flow, this is an experience like no other, blending mindful tag gameplay with immersive, skill-based movement.

In Project Pepsi, the goal is simple, but the journey is intense. As you leap, swing, and maneuver with precision, staying centered is key—your hands are everything. The rules are easy to pick up, but mastering movement, outsmarting opponents, or maintaining inner balance takes practice, awareness, and a calm tag-ready mindset. Whether you’re the chaser or the one being chased, the thrill never fades as you explore the vibrant world around you.

Get ready for a game that challenges you both physically and mentally, packed with surprises and moments of pure tag adrenaline. Whether you’re a seasoned tag player or brand new to movement-based gameplay, Project Pepsi has something for everyone. Take a breath, warm up those hands, and jump into an experience where agility, focus, and fun collide.
